summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K announcing the purchase of 31,145,279 ordinary shares on 29 April 2026 at a VWAP of 97.166 pence per share as part of an ongoing share buyback programme instructed on 29 January 2026. Shares will be cancelled. No stated premium, board advisor, or regulatory clock. Foreign issuer filing maps to domestic issuer tender rules. What to watch: the pace and completion of the buyback against announced programme. Risk-arb: none as this is an open-market repurchase, not a fixed-price tender.
